findings.title: markFindingsClosed (batch) writes index.json outside withClosedJsonLock — TOCTOU window
findings.detail: markFindingsClosed() in audit-runner.ts called writeAuditIndex(indexPath, index) BEFORE entering withClosedJsonLock. A crash between the writeAuditIndex call and the withClosedJsonLock block leaves index.json showing findings as closed while closed.json is missing the closure records. The singular markFindingClosed was already fixed (AUDIT-IFleet-d651330f), but the batch variant had the same bug.
findings.fix_sketch: Moved writeAuditIndex inside the withClosedJsonLock callback so both index.json and closed.json updates are atomic. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: Second bare unthrottled Octokit in daemon.ts for makeProductionFactory — bypasses retry plugin
findings.detail: daemon.ts line 157 constructed new Octokit({ auth: githubToken }) to pass to makeProductionFactory. AUDIT-IFleet-d16b51f8 fixed the GitHubQueue Octokit, but this second construction site was missed. Under rate-limit pressure, the production factory's Octokit client (used for PR creation and repo operations) will receive 429s that are never retried, causing PR creation failures.
findings.fix_sketch: Exported createThrottledOctokit from src/queue/github.ts and used it instead of bare new Octokit in daemon.ts. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: standup.ts uses stale event kind 'task.done' — completedCount always reports 0
findings.detail: src/agents/rituals/standup.ts checked e.kind === 'task.done' but the orchestrator emits 'task.completed'. The mismatch caused the daily standup to always report 0 completed tasks, misleading the team about fleet throughput.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed 'task.done' to 'task.completed' on line 78. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: drainDiscordOutbox JSON.parse can dead-letter valid non-JSON messages
findings.detail: In Orchestrator.drainDiscordOutbox(), JSON.parse(payload) was not wrapped in try/catch. Outbox messages that are plain-text strings (not JSON objects) would throw a SyntaxError, causing them to be dead-lettered on every drain attempt instead of delivered. Any message written to the outbox as a raw string would be permanently lost.
findings.fix_sketch: Wrapped JSON.parse in try/catch; on parse failure, treats the raw payload as the message content. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: auto-router.ts caches Haiku error fallback for 10 min, degrading routing quality
findings.detail: On a Haiku LLM call failure, the error fallback decision was written to the LRU cache with the full CACHE_TTL_MS (10 min). Subsequent tasks with the same routing key within the next 10 minutes received the stale error-fallback instead of a fresh routing attempt, even after the transient error resolved.
findings.fix_sketch: Removed cache.set() from the error catch block so failed calls are never cached. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: listSprintsByStateKind N+1 SQLite query pattern — one query per sprint row
findings.detail: StateStore.listSprintsByStateKind() issued a separate 'SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE sprint_id = ?' for each sprint row returned by the initial filter. With N active sprints this is N+1 queries. Under load with many sprints this becomes a significant bottleneck on the tick loop.
findings.fix_sketch: Replaced N individual task queries with a single batch query using IN (?, ?, ...) and grouped results by sprint_id in memory. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: markCompleted passes empty string prUrl when no PR — corrupts GitHub comment and Discord message
findings.detail: In sprint-bridge.ts, adapter.markCompleted(task, lastPrUrl ?? '', totalTokens) passed '' when no PR was opened (no-changes-needed, already-resolved completions). GitHubQueue.markCompleted() posted '✅ Completed — PR: ' to the issue comment. The QueueAdapter interface typed prUrl as string, enforcing the empty string workaround.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed prUrl to optional (prUrl?: string) across QueueAdapter, TaskSource, DiscordOut, and all implementations. GitHub comment now reads '✅ Completed (no PR — already resolved or no changes needed)' when prUrl is absent. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: computeStructuralFingerprint uses hardcoded baseRef='main' ignoring per-repo default branch
findings.detail: pr-decisions.ts:149 passed baseRef: 'main' to computeStructuralFingerprint. Repositories whose default branch is not 'main' (e.g. 'master', 'trunk') would produce incorrect structural fingerprints, corrupting the PR-rejection learning signal used by the bandit.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed to baseRef: bootstrap.input.baseBranch ?? 'main' so the configured default branch is used when available. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: markCancelled TOCTOU — fromState guard absent on store.updateState call
findings.detail: UnifiedQueueAdapter.markCancelled() checked current.state before calling store.updateState() but did not pass fromState to updateState, leaving a race window: if the task transitioned to done/failed between getById and updateState, the completed state would be overwritten with blocked+cancelled. The existing non-atomic check at lines 111-114 was a best-effort guard, not a database-level atomic guarantee.
findings.fix_sketch: Added fromState: current.state as fourth argument to store.updateState() and checked the returned boolean to bail out when the state changed concurrently. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: standup.ts has duplicate node:fs import split across two import statements
findings.detail: src/agents/rituals/standup.ts imported existsSync and readdirSync from 'node:fs' on one line and readFileSync on a separate 'node:fs' import. Duplicate module imports are redundant and can confuse tree-shaking analysis.
findings.fix_sketch: Merged into a single import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: candidate-gen.ts trailing blank line inside defaultWarn function body
findings.detail: src/agents/proposer/candidate-gen.ts had a spurious blank line between the function opening brace and console.warn, causing inconsistent formatting.
findings.fix_sketch: Removed trailing whitespace. Fixed in this run.

findings.title: store-extensions.ts duplicates bandit_arm_state DDL already defined in circuit-breaker.ts
findings.detail: The banditArmState StoreExtension in src/agents/bandit/store-extensions.ts contained an inline CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bandit_arm_state DDL that was identical to the one in ensureCircuitBreakerSchema() in circuit-breaker.ts. Schema drift between the two copies could silently corrupt the bandit state table on future schema updates.
findings.fix_sketch: Replaced the inline DDL in store-extensions.ts with a call to ensureCircuitBreakerSchema(db). Fixed in this run.

findings.title: interaction-create.ts leaks IFLEET_PROPOSALS_APPROVER_IDS env var name in Discord user-visible message
findings.detail: When IFLEET_PROPOSALS_APPROVER_IDS was unset, the error message sent to Discord users contained the literal string 'IFLEET_PROPOSALS_APPROVER_IDS is not configured'. Internal environment variable names are implementation details that should not be exposed to end users in a Discord channel.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed user-facing message to 'Proposal approvals are not yet configured. Please ask an operator to enable them.' Fixed in this run.
